    The tracial-ultraproduct quotient is a C*-algebra (instance assembly) #

    Supplies the approximate-unit facts (‖1-u‖≤1, star u = u) from the committed l2NullIdeal_has_approxUnit to the order-free C*-identity inequality norm_mul_self_le_star_mul, then declares CStarRing and CStarAlgebra on MatrixSeqQuotient dim ω σ. This is the only file combining the NormedRing (4b) and spectral-order (4c) imports, kept small so their elaboration cost is bounded.

    source
    @[implicit_reducible]
    noncomputable instance ZFib.CEP.instMatrixSeqAlgCStarAlgebra {dim : ℕ → ℕ} :
    CStarAlgebra ↥(MatrixSeqAlg dim)

    The bounded matrix-sequence algebra is a (unital) C*-algebra: Mathlib gives lp _ ∞ only the non-unital instance + NormedRing separately, so we assemble the unital CStarAlgebra from the parts.
